notes.title: Zombo Buster Advance is now on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26219122/38f156c7e95d3ed2e033ca829b2257f0195286df.png[/img]

We are pleased to announce that Zombo Buster Advance is now available on Steam.
Get the game while it's hot with launch discount and be the first to play the game!
Store page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1302780/Zombo_Buster_Advance/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1302780/Zombo_Buster_Advance/[/url]

Key Features
- Lead a team of 12+ anti zombie shooters into the operation.
- Craft and equip power up badges to your units, create your own super soldiers.
- Fight against 30+ kinds of zombies and engage in epic boss battles.
- Make good use of various supportive gadgets in the war zone, from dynamites to the Kill-with-snap - gauntlets!
- Use your tactics to counter the in-game flow changer such as the escalator, travelators, passages and many others.
- Forge ahead a total of 50 fun and challenging stages worth of hours playing.
- Examine your units, enemies, gadgets and others with the in-game game journal.
- Complete a series of missions and claim the rewards.
- As always, a bunch of upgrades!

Language barrier? No worries!
Zombo Buster Advance will support multiple languages for you!

List of supported languages:
- English
- Portuguese (Brazil)
- Spanish (Spain)
- Russian
- Polish
- German
- French
- Italian
- Simp. Chinese
- Trad. Chinese
- Japanese
- Korean

- FIREBEAST TEAM -
